# Public leak-guard tier: structural path rules only, one regex per line, matched against
# repo-relative file paths (never file content). Term patterns belong in the private tier, the
# LEAK_DENYLIST Actions secret, because a term listed here is itself a disclosure.

# Environment files (an .env.example template is fine).
(^|/)\.env(\.(?!example$)[^/]+)?$

# Key material.
\.(pem|key|p12|pfx|jks|keystore)$
(^|/)keystores?/
(^|/)id_(rsa|ecdsa|ed25519)$
